sentences.text: In short: BORETTSLAGET ERLEVEIEN 53 is an established company in "aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier" based in Bergen, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
BORETTSLAGET ERLEVEIEN 53 is registered in the industry "Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier"; its statutory purpose reads "Borettslag.".
BORETTSLAGET ERLEVEIEN 53 is a housing cooperative (BRL), founded on 1992-09-09, registered in Bergen.
It reported revenue of NOK 2.15M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 895,739 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 41.7% and a strong equity ratio of 64% of total assets.

Revenue was flat from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 2.15M to NOK 2.15M); it was NOK 2.17M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 694,332, 2024: NOK 430,553, 2025: NOK 916,628).
BORETTSLAGET ERLEVEIEN 53 is led by board chair Randi Helene Mørk.
It has a board of 3. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-05-27 (within the past year).
